mechanism: Isoniazid may impair calcium absorption and increase risk of hypocalcemia, which could compromise the therapeutic effect of alendronate and increase osteoporosis/fracture risk in TB patients on long-term bisphosphonate therapy.
action: Monitor serum calcium and vitamin D levels; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider timing separation of administration (alendronate on empty stomach in morning, isoniazid at different time); assess bone health status periodically.
